summary: [Wizard] The selected brand (logo and name) is no longer shown after the Brand & Country step
steps: Log in to staging GEO (organisation QA-GEO, interface language English (United Kingdom)) and click New Analysis
Brand & Country: type "Licter", select the suggestion "Licter / licter.com" (its logo shows on the brand card), pick United Kingdom / English
Click Discover Categories and look at the top of the wizard on the Categories step
expected: TO CONFIRM (PO): as in production 1.2, once the brand is chosen the wizard keeps showing it (logo + name) on the following steps. Note: the GEO-1231 rule removes the "New analysis" top bar ("Back to Dashboard in the sidebar replaces it"), which also removed the brand block; the brand could be shown elsewhere (e.g. above the stepper).
actual: Staging 1.3: no brand block at all from the Categories step on (no logo, no name, no lettermark); the sidebar starts with "CREATE NEW ANALYSIS". The brand name only appears in the subtitle "We detected these categories for Licter". Same with a custom brand + website (licter.com). The logo itself loads fine on the Brand & Country card (Brandfetch 200).
